mapper.select: SELECT d.*, t.task_code, t.task_name FROM quality_defect d LEFT JOIN quality_task t ON t.id = d.task_id WHERE d.id = #{id} AND d.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quality_defect (defect_code, task_id, image_id, exceeded_metrics, exceeded_values, standard_ranges, found_at, dispose_status, verify_status, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by) VALUES (#{defectCode}, #{taskId}, #{imageId}, #{exceededMetrics}, #{exceededValues}, #{standardRanges}, NOW(), 1, 0, NOW(), #{createdBy}, NOW(), #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE quality_defect SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT defect_code FROM quality_defect WHERE defect_code LIKE CONCAT('DEF-',#{dateStr},'%') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DATE(found_at) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN dispose_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS disposed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN verify_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS verified_count FROM quality_defect WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND DATE(found_at) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(found_at) <= #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(found_at) ORDER BY stat_date

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN dispose_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_count, SUM(CASE WHEN dispose_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN dispose_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS disposed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN dispose_status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ignored_count, SUM(CASE WHEN verify_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS verified_pass_count, SUM(CASE WHEN verify_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS verified_fail_count FROM quality_defect WHERE is_deleted = 0
